description: Checks one resume bullet of a project, program or product manager, TPM or PMO lead with rules written by practitioners. Use it when someone asks about a single line or wants to test a rewrite of it. Returns one finding and the question a hiring manager may ask about that line. 5 words to 500 characters, English; contact details are removed first; nothing is stored.

lang.description: The language the person writes in, as a code such as es, fr or ru; empty or en for English. The result names this language; findings are written in English.
lang.title: Lang

line.description: One resume bullet as the person wrote it, 5 words to 500 characters. Several lines: the first full line is checked.
line.title: Line

role.description: Optional. One of project-manager, program-manager, technical-program-manager, product-manager, scrum-master, pmo, it-manager, business-analyst, delivery-manager; a title as written (for example Senior Program Manager) is also read. Empty when not sure.
role.title: Role

text_en.description: Only when the text is not in English: a literal English translation of it, word for word, with no fact added or left out and figures and names as written. The fixed rules read this translation, and the result says so.
text_en.title: Text En

name: check_resume_line
title: Check a resume line
